notes.title: Update Maintenance Announcement

notes.content:

1. Gold card striker. Randomly give 83-87 gold card strikers, need 6 frontcourt players, 2 gold cards, 2 flash silver. I don't understand you when you enter the illustration book at this point, the goalkeeper has it, and there is also 89 flash gold. Please consult the planner.

It needs to be composed of three players from different leagues, 3 flash silver cards, 3 gold cards, anything else, tacit understanding 10, score 860. You can try this, Jin Cardo said.

notes.title: "Soccer Clubs" alliance gameplay
notes.content:
[h3] Share my league experience with managers today. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/5840e98172a8b44ecce343c34d27f645405ba202.png[/img]

There is an alliance under the team on the joining page of the alliance. Click to enter and you can choose to create an alliance. You can choose your favorite badge and name, and you can also set whether it needs to be reviewed. The level limit of the application can also be set. As long as the alliance management is set, Very easy to manage.
Next, we enter the alliance. The first thing we see is the headquarters building of the alliance. Inside, we can see who is offline for too long or who has not contributed. You can impeach him even if the president has not been around for a long time, and invite him down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/cb468c9ea2f1c08d8f84b40037d560372f863055.png[/img]

There is a youth training center on the right. Click to enter the youth training report for the youth training players. In the lower right corner, you can draw a lottery for youth training coins. The youth training coins are used to shoot players. There are gold cards and flash gold. Then there is the training policy of the youth training players, which has an impact on the weekly output of the youth training players' ratings. Youth coaches and mentors can have an impact on this. The facilities are related to the various technological levels of the alliance, and they will be automatically opened when they meet the requirements. The youth training market is produced every Monday and the youth training players are auctioned off last week. I have photographed Varane in 20001. Every player has an estimate. If the auction fails, it will enter the server-wide auction on Tuesday, and the income will be shared equally among union members.
The building in the lower right corner of the alliance is a store, with alliance level rewards, where you can get various development materials, flash card coach fragments, etc. When the alliance reaches the fourth and fifth levels, there will be pieces of the goalkeeper, which can be bought every day.
The middle and lower buildings are office buildings where you can submit tasks and receive contribution progress rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/dd8a947b3f18362a8cbedf079de712ca73d2a411.png[/img]

On the left is the research institute, which can respectively improve the court damage reduction, transfer share, player attributes, arena recovery, league store level, and arena damage bonus.
The alliance task gives gifts three times a day, and you can get alliance research and development points, physical strength and alliance contribution. Allies receive special training coupons and alliance contributions.

notes.title: "Soccer Clubs" coaching gameplay
notes.content:
[h3] Every team will start the coaching game at level 40. Today I will share with you the coaching game experience. [/h3]
First of all, the coach is the main channel to enhance the combat power, so everyone must do a good job in the coach first, the combat power of the players is incomparable with the coach.
Click to enter the coaches page, and a list of coaches will appear to show the members of your coaching staff. So far, there are two purple-card coaches, Mourinho and Guardiola, three gold-card coaches, three gold-card coaches, and two silver-card coaches. coach. Zika coaches and flash gold basic coaches come out at the carnival, magic birds will appear every day with physical strength (twice a day), flash gold coach league level gift packs, team challenges and other channels can produce some spare parts. The main thing is that Coach Carnival and Coach Zi will come out together.

As for the fragments, you can see the collection progress of your coach at any time.
In the coach settings, there are options for the head coach's tactical settings, assistant coaches, physical coaches, goalkeeper coaches, and technical directors. Below is the rotation player setting option (I think the substitute bonus is not very high, so you don't need to pursue it deliberately).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/e7954e4ebce782357e685dccfe28c047c8438449.png[/img]

The coach also has his own illustration book, so far a total of four can be activated, and the corresponding illustration book for each coach will increase the effect of star promotion. The coach can still be reborn, mainly to optimize resources as much as possible.

Every time you click on a coach's avatar, the current coach's development module will appear, and you can see the coach's attributes, tactics, and good formations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/a132e8456964091af2da40206c2f63f2f9edae37.png[/img]

Each coach can also be promoted to a star, up to five stars, which will activate certain formations and tactics. Intimacy is to increase the attributes of the coach, and intimacy can also increase the attributes of the players in the team. Finally, the coaches of each quality can be inlaid with tactics books of the corresponding quality (the increase in combat power of the tactics book is also considerable, but it is relatively difficult to obtain, and I hope to plan a large production activity of the tactics book).

notes.title: "Soccer Clubs" formation collocation
notes.content:
[h3][b]① 4-2-2-2[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/9352da50ecf8c57345a562782d0f0d56e6b00483.png[/img]
[h3]4-2-2-2 is a counterattack nightmare[/h3]
I think this formation should be very popular in the game, why? Because 4-2-2-2 is an excellent balanced formation, it is very balanced and practical in offense and defense, mainly through defensive counterattacks and high-speed breakthroughs on the side.
Four defenders and two defensive midfielders will have a very solid defensive control, and the fault tolerance rate is also high, which greatly exerts the ability of the defensive players. This formation does not require much additional offensive assistance from them, because the two front The striker and two attacking midfielders provide plenty of attacking options, enough to tear through the opposition's backline.
At the tactical level, after stealing from the backcourt, quickly throw the ball out to find the striker in the frontcourt, or the fullback uses his own speed to counterattack and pass through, and cooperate with the striker to complete an effective and powerful attack.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]
Defensively stable
Attacking midfielders bring great range and options

[h3]Disadvantages:[/h3]
The midfielder leaves more space for the opponent
The connection between front and back courts is easy to be divided by opponents


[h3][b]② 3-5-2[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/6143fcde4c84935a3b89b47f8ea4824802d1e716.png[/img]
[h3]Common three-back formation[/h3]
Generally, it is very risky to choose three backs. This formation has high requirements for wing backs and central backs. It really needs the kind of high-quality players. They need to handle the ball well enough at their feet and have good marking ability . In addition, for this formation, you need a lagging player to protect the formation, and at the same time, the position of the wing back can also be flexible in defense, rather than just three defenders bearing the pressure.
For the 3-5-2 it will be quite good in terms of numbers in the midfield and control of the game. You can rest assured that the ball is under the feet of your own players, and you can cut off the opponent's offensive thinking, realize the diversified cooperation between your midfielder and frontcourt players, and complete a smooth team offensive show.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]
Quality players form a solid defense
firmly control the midfield

[h3]Disadvantages:[/h3]
High-efficiency wingbacks needed
Zhongwei has high quality requirements and low error tolerance rate


[h3][b]③ 4-2-3-1 (compact)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/5efa5a6730881b3b00d1f32a41d60f0e74b26aac.png[/img]
[h3]4-2-3-1 maintained a very high balance for the team[/h3]
The 4-2-3-1 formation is the choice of many people. There is everything you want in this formation. The switching between offense and defense satisfies the balance and flexibility of the lineup. A single striker can provide a lot of cover and tactical support on offense. The arrangement of three offensive midfielders is very suitable for those who like to attack through the center. The various positions and tactical coordination of the three will be very scary in the opponent's half. In turn, it can directly suppress and contain the opponent's entire center defense.
If you want to use this formation properly, having two strong holding midfielders is the key to making this formation work. You need a player who has stamina, who can run and do the dirty work, who can dribble and pass well, who can read the game and control the tempo. In the end, if you want to take it to the next level and create the most perfect offensive and defensive transition football, two all-around full-backs are also indispensable.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]
Flexible and balanced offense and defense
strong midfielder

[h3]Disadvantages:[/h3]
A striker can struggle to find space, not many chances
Weakness on the sides of the lower back


[h3][b]④ 4-3-3 (ball possession)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/0bcf09a309f3c909c8fd35226960fed5c9ab2c19.png[/img]
[h3]The set of 4-3-3 depends on an excellent and perfect core[/h3]
4-3-3 is very suitable for building around players with strong defensive ability and strong wingers. Without the support of excellent wingers, the ability to attack and suppress opponents under this formation will be very weak.
Of course, in addition to this, you need one of the strong defensive midfielders in this formation to be able to hold the team's center; while the other two midfielders must be good at counterattacks and creating space, playing the role of B2B and taking on the responsibility of the entire team. The ball is in control. Otherwise, if one link is missing, it will not be able to exert the greatest effect and the full body effect that this formation should have.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]
Excellent offensive width
strong midfield core

[h3]Disadvantages:[/h3]
High quality requirements for players
highly dependent on winger ability


[h3][b]⑤ 3-4-1-2[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/d495a05a3178e141aa05d61ac99d707a30746c8e.png[/img]
[h3]3-4-1-2 is very suitable for counter-attacking football[/h3]
Another formation that opts for a back three, the 3-4-1-2 is an attacking version of the 3-5-2 and packs a real punch. There is a lot of choice between the midfield and the two strikers, this formation is absolutely powerful on the counter-attack and the layering is also very good.
However, in turn this also leaves you vulnerable defensively, so you need efficient wingers running aggressively and at least one speedy centre-back to fill the gap and make up for the lack of shape.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]
Incredible counter attack
Two strikers ravage the opposition defense

[h3]Disadvantages:[/h3]
Three backs under pressure
Needs a speedy centre-back and aggressive winger


[h3][b]⑥ 4-4-2 (D) (compact)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/ba5e81a446089fb385c3a5351ce7530bf6ffd693.png[/img]
[h3] Relying on 4-4-2 (D) to dominate the midfield[/h3]
Another narrow formation, the 4-4-2 (D) formation, the midfielder can make a lot of passing and attacking options, and the pressure on the opponent is huge. Therefore, the key to achieving such an effect reasonably is: first, to have an excellent offensive midfielder. If he is a player with a high inverse foot star, he can fulfill the offensive needs of the formation with ease, quality and quantity; in addition, the choice of midfielder It is not only the interception ability, but also the passing and reaction speed that are very important.
In the game, we are often used to breaking the formation selection of a single center forward, so choosing a narrow formation such as 4-4-2 (D) also takes advantage of this, and this formation is also very solid and solid, and the defense runs through the middle. Finally: If you choose this formation, you must arrange your defenders reasonably to protect the wings.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]
Excellent ball control
excellent midfield depth

[h3]Disadvantages:[/h3]
Insufficient width, the wings are easily exposed
counter attack


The above is the powerful formation in the game Soccer Clubs. Of course, this needs to be combined with the formation bonus of your own coaches to select the formation. The formation bonus of the flash gold coach is 8%, and the formation bonus of the purple card coach is 10%. Then according to your own The player's lineup to choose the appropriate formation.
